unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The local primary XML/PDF text states qualitative HaCaT cytotoxicity and references Figure A3; exact database percentages are not present as text/table values.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Exact DBAASP percentages are retained as source_conflict cautions; qualitative toxicity conclusion remains source-supported.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP contains exact HaCaT killing percentages, but the primary XML/PDF text provides qualitative no/moderate cytotoxicity and Figure A3 context rather than extractable numeric bars.
The paper supports MIC, biofilm, morphology, and FIC phenotypes; direct membrane or intracellular target mechanisms are background context and not final claims.
DBAASP names such as NCR335 (48-64) are mapped to source Table 1 names such as NCR335C17-33, with the mapping retained in database audit rows.
